text: Over the beach, a single ship begins to descend.
Anyone who can travel between stars would be far ahead of us.
The soldiers form a line, five hundred metres back.
Behind them, thousands of people who refused to stay home.
Light pours out onto the sand.
And for the first time in history, we know for certain… we are not alone.
If they stepped out tomorrow… would you walk out to meet them, or lock your door?
